name: UsageWindow
description: Usage statistics for a single time window.

service_calls_used.description: Non-icon API calls consumed in this window.

service_calls_limit.description: Maximum non-icon API calls allowed in this window.

icon_calls_used.description: Icon-specific calls consumed in this window.

icon_calls_limit.description: Maximum icon-specific calls allowed in this window.

period_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this window started.

period_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this window ends.
